details.effect: Drain. [fanfare] [cost03]: Search your deck for an Apostle of Craving and Craving's Splendor, put them into your EX area, then shuffle your deck. [fanfare] If each player has 10 maximum play points, draw 3 cards. Whenever you play a [neutral] card, deal 1 damage to each enemy leader.

issues: The card should not include "fanfare" in keywords; Fanfare should be represented by abilities with timing "fanfare", not as a keyword.

The second Fanfare condition is wrong: "If each player has 10 maximum play points" is not equivalent to condition.type "ppMin" count 10. It should check both players' maximum play points; encode with an appropriate both-players-max-PP condition instead.

The triggered ability says "deal 1 damage to each enemy leader," but the encoding only deals 1 damage to a single enemy leader target. It should hit each enemy leader simultaneously; add/use an effect that damages all enemy leaders or supports multiplayer leader-wide damage.

The onCardPlayed ability puts the card restriction at the ability root as "filter", which is not a valid ability wrapper field in the reference. The neutral-card restriction should be encoded using a supported card-play trigger filter mechanism.
The card should not include "fanfare" in keywords; Fanfare should be represented by the fanfare ability only.

The source has "Stack.", but the encoding only uses keyword "earthSigil" and omits the stack implementation. It should include the Earth Sigil/Stack representation used by the engine, such as an addStack/passive stack-related encoding if required by your card model.
